name: Sentry Error Tracking MCP
shortDescription: Retrieve error stack traces, triage application issues, inspect breadcrumbs, and diagnose production crashes.
longDescription: Connect Sentry error and performance telemetry directly to your AI assistant. Debug stack traces, identify root causes of uncaught exceptions, and query issue metrics across projects.
author: getsentry

envVars.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
envVars.description: Sentry User Auth Token with issue:read and org:read scopes.

tools.name: get_issue_details
tools.description: Fetch stack trace and diagnostic metadata for a specific issue ID.

tools.name: list_recent_issues
tools.description: List active, unresolved issues in a project.
